headline: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) Could Be 43% Undervalued On Bylaw Changes And Share Price Weakness
summary: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) has just overhauled its bylaws, reshaping how shareholders can nominate directors, submit proposals, and call special meetings. These governance changes arrive while the stock is still trading well below its recent highs. See our latest analysis for Intuitive Surgical.
